title: Sombi, Milk Rice with Fromage Blanc
author: Amina Savoura (Afrik)
desc: 200 g of round rice cooked in 40 cl of water for about 20 minutes until the water is absorbed, then enriched with butter, evaporated milk, fromage blanc, sugar, nutmeg, cinnamon and orange blossom — no coconut.
longDesc: The one sombi printing with no coconut at all. Round rice is cooked in 40 cl of water over medium heat for about 20 minutes ‘until the water is completely absorbed’, then a knob of butter and a pinch of salt are added; the pan is removed from the heat and stirred with the evaporated milk, the fromage blanc caillé, sugar, vanilla sugar, nutmeg, cinnamon and orange blossom. ‘Le riz au lait est prêt.’ The page adds that another variant of sombi is made with the local red rice, mostly for wedding ceremonies.
steps: Put 40 cl of water in a saucepan. Add the rice.
Cook over medium heat for about 20 minutes, until the water is completely absorbed.
Add the knob of butter and a small pinch of salt. Mix and remove the pan from the heat.
Add the evaporated milk, fromage blanc, sugar, vanilla sugar, a pinch of nutmeg and of cinnamon, and the orange blossom. Mix well. The rice pudding is ready.
chefTips: Printed cue: ‘until the water is completely absorbed’, paired with about 20 minutes.
Add the dairy and sugar off the heat.
The page names a red-rice wedding variant but gives no recipe for it.
commonMistakes: Starting from cooked rice — this version starts from raw round rice.
Adding the sweet milk while the pan is still on the heat.
Using long-grain rice and getting a looser pudding.
healthBenefits: A source of calcium from the dairy; high in sugar.
culturalNote: ‘Une autre variante du sombi est préparée à base de riz rouge local’ — the page says another variant uses local red rice and is mostly made for wedding ceremonies. Three sombi printings disagree fundamentally on the base: see SEN083 and SEN084.
sources: Title as printed: ‘Sombi’. Byline: Amina Savoura. Publication: Afrik (afrik.com), category Culture. Date: ‘Publié le 4 août 2016 à 18h09’. Yield: ‘Pour 2 personnes’. TWO-PASS, identical.
Cue, direct quote: ‘jusqu’à ce que l’eau soit complètement absorbée’ with ‘20 min environ’.

UNRECONCILED, major: this is a non-coconut dish; SEN083 and SEN084 are coconut-based American printings that also disagree with each other by a factor of two. This one starts from RAW rice; the other two start from cooked rice, so the ratios are not comparable.
